business_rules.description: Missing or zero OHLC is never treated as stale.

business_rules.description: A trading-session date runs boundary-to-boundary, not midnight-to-midnight.

business_rules.description: 404s are tracked only for unauthenticated, non-crawler paths.

business_rules.description: A fractional quantity is rejected for every non-crypto exchange.

business_rules.description: quantity must be strictly positive; price/trigger_price/disclosed_quantity must be non-negative.
business_rules.condition: range validators on every order schema

business_rules.description: OCO requires all four leg prices with triggerprice_sl less than triggerprice_tg; SINGLE requires exactly one positive trigger.

business_rules.description: GTT permits only CNC/NRML; options permit only MIS/NRML.

business_rules.description: Options multi-order accepts 1-20 legs; the margin calculator accepts 1-50 positions.

hidden_business_logic.implicit_rule: A process-wide Engine connect listener applies WAL + synchronous=NORMAL + busy_timeout to every SQLite connection, including all 35 broker master_contract_db modules that declare none of it.
Middleware effect order is socketio, CSRF, limiter, CORS, CSP, socketio-error, IP-ban, traffic logging; traffic logging is outermost so it sees the final status including bans.
Four brokers silently use REST polling instead of a push feed, for reasons recorded only in comments.
Events past 1000 pending are DROPPED, not queued; a slow alert subscriber can silently lose notifications.
Traffic logging skips its own endpoints and static assets, so the traffic monitor cannot observe traffic-monitor access and latency-log reads are untracked.
Every non-static request blocks up to 30 s for background DB init: an availability coupling between request serving and a boot thread.
The strategy book must subscribe before db_ready is set, because order.placed carries the only copy of the strategy tag; an earlier order is permanently unattributable.
Uniqueness on gtt_leg_id is the crash-safety mechanism that stops a replayed GTT claim from creating a second child order.
The SUB socket binds and publishers connect, inverting the usual PUB-binds convention so the rendezvous port is deterministic across processes.
The server mirrors the browser's evaluateTrail algorithm; a divergence between them would silently disagree about the stop level.
APScheduler job stores are persisted, so jobs survive restarts and are reconciled at boot rather than redefined.

documentation_contradictions.documented_claim: kb/overview.md and kb/architecture.md state the kb notes are unfilled starter templates describing an empty project.
documentation_contradictions.actual_implementation: The repository is a fully implemented 2,440-file trading platform with 35 broker plugins and a React frontend.
documentation_contradictions.discrepancy_impact: The project's own knowledge base provides no orientation and would mislead an agent into treating the project as empty. Code (Tier 3) wins over docs (Tier 6).

documentation_contradictions.documented_claim: kb/gotchas.md says the ZMQ port is 5555.
documentation_contradictions.actual_implementation: The code default is 5555 but the shipped .sample.env sets ZMQ_PORT=9555, so a standard install runs 9555 (Tier 2 config beats Tier 5 default).
documentation_contradictions.discrepancy_impact: An operator following the note would watch the wrong port when diagnosing a bind conflict.

documentation_contradictions.documented_claim: The product is branded and documented as OpenAlgo (env header, startup banner, docs links).
documentation_contradictions.actual_implementation: The repository folder and launcher are qwantonomous while pyproject.toml names the package openalgoUI and depends on openalgo==2.0.3.
documentation_contradictions.discrepancy_impact: Three disagreeing product identities in one tree; anything keyed on the product name becomes inconsistent.

documentation_contradictions.actual_implementation: Code default and docker-compose both use 8765.
documentation_contradictions.discrepancy_impact: A user copying .sample.env runs on 9999 while the container manifest and SDK examples assume 8765.

documentation_contradictions.documented_claim: .sample.env warns not to bind ZMQ to 0.0.0.0.
documentation_contradictions.actual_implementation: Consistent with the code: the SUB binds tcp://{ZMQ_HOST}:{ZMQ_PORT} and publishers connect.
documentation_contradictions.discrepancy_impact: none (recorded to show the check was performed)

documentation_contradictions.documented_claim: kb/architecture.md documents components as path/to/module with entry points at path/to/file.py:NN.
documentation_contradictions.actual_implementation: No such modules exist; the project's own KB conventions require searchable path#symbol references and forbid line numbers.
documentation_contradictions.discrepancy_impact: Following the template would plant brittle, unresolvable pointers.

documentation_contradictions.documented_claim: CI runs Ruff lint/format and bandit/pip-audit.
documentation_contradictions.actual_implementation: All four steps carry continue-on-error: true, so none can fail the build.
documentation_contradictions.discrepancy_impact: A green CI badge does not evidence clean lint or a clean security audit; findings pass silently.

documentation_contradictions.documented_claim: The product is version 2.0.2.1 (release note and pyproject).
documentation_contradictions.actual_implementation: .sample.env self-identifies as ENV_CONFIG_VERSION 1.0.7 while utils/version.py#get_version is the runtime source.
documentation_contradictions.discrepancy_impact: Three independent version cursors with no demonstrated synchronisation; version diagnostics key off different numbers.
